thread:
morgan: Heads-up — a customer reported double billing when a streaming request was handed off mid-stream to a fallback. Console showed both a provisional and a committed row; support saw both counted. Can we clarify ownership?

ada: Do we have the router trace + stream chunk indexes? Need to know if fallback emitted a separate billing span.

morgan: Trace snippet (redacted):
TRACE tr-9a7 route: model-a -> model-b-quant @ chunk=42 metrics: provisional_tokens=483 final_tokens=510 billing_events: provisional=true final=true logs: router: "handoff created billing_anchor=anc-123"

kai: Looks like provisional was emitted then final committed without de-duping on an anchor. We need a canonical billing anchor that all components honor.

morgan: Proposal: router assigns server-side anchor (x-rw-billing-anchor) on first accept. Downstream nodes echo it in stream delta events as billing_anchor. Billing service dedupes on anchor+sequence-range. Example header: X-RW-Billing-Anchor: anc-123; stream delta includes billing_anchor and chunk_index.

ada: Questions: 1) if we swap models and a backend doesn't echo header, how do we stitch? 2) how do we surface provisional vs committed in Console for support?

kai: For (1) router should keep anchor in handoff metadata; billing can stitch by trace id if echo missing, but we should require echo for full guarantees and roll out compatibility flags. For (2) Console should show reserved vs committed tokens and TTL for reservations.

sanjay: Quotas: are provisional tokens immediately counted against quota? If so customers can hit quota on speculative tokens. We should separate reserved_tokens vs consumed_tokens metrics. Reserved reduces available quota until finalization or TTL expiry.

claire: Console mock idea: Debug view shows a timeline bar per request: gray = reserved, green = committed, red = reversed. Add a toggle to hide speculative charges in exports and a control to clear stale reservations. I'll draft copy explaining speculative vs committed.

adA: (typo fixed) I'll update internal API spec and add compatibility notes for older model backends.

kai: I'll add dedupe logic in billing service behind a feature flag and author end-to-end tests simulating reconnects and mid-stream handoffs. Tests assert no double-charge within 24h if anchor matches.

morgan: Edge-case: mid-stream tool calls. Tool containers must receive billing_anchor in toolcall RPC context and attribute tokens to that anchor; tools must not mint new anchors.

ops-bot: Deploy plan: router-anchor-canary -> 2026-03-24T03:00Z, model-echo-agent -> 2026-03-25T04:00Z, billing-dedupe -> 2026-03-26T05:00Z. :white_check_mark:

morgan: Action items:
- router: attach anchor on accept (kai)
- model nodes: echo billing_anchor (ada)
- billing: dedupe on anchor+range (kai)
- console: show reserved vs committed + TTL controls (claire)
- docs: update internal API spec (ada)
- tests: e2e reconnect/handoff scenarios (kai + ada)

morgan: TL;DR: introduce server-side billing anchor + reserved vs committed telemetry + Console UX to prevent double-billing and make support debugging easier.

ada: SGTM. Monitor metrics: rw_billing_reserved_tokens_total and rw_billing_committed_tokens_total during canary. :rocket:

claire: I'll post the mock in #eng-platform when ready.

morgan: I'll create the epic and link PRs.

(ops-bot pinned: billing anchor RFC draft link)
